one_liner: AI-drafted family trip itineraries from Tier-2 cities, with local guides, taxis and stays booked and confirmed manually on WhatsApp; earns a 12% commission on booking value.
sub_sector: Travel tech / family holiday packages (agency operations with an LLM itinerary front end)
ask: INR 1.2 Cr at INR 8 Cr post-money (form); the deck states no amount
business_model: Commission (12%) on total booking value of trips assembled from local guides, taxis and stays; bookings confirmed manually on WhatsApp. Founder-stated GBV INR 38.6 L and revenue INR 4.6 L since launch.

founders.name: Manish Joshi
founders.background_claimed: 10 years running his family's travel agency in Jaipur, which has served over 3,000 families. Prior startup experience: has run a family business.
founders.background_verified: Not verified. LinkedIn link given is a placeholder (linkedin.com/in/manish-joshi-example). Web search for name + Yatrika + Jaipur returned no matching person or agency; the family agency is not named in the application.

founders.name: Kavya Nair
founders.background_claimed: 3 years as a web developer. No prior startup experience.
founders.background_verified: Not verified. LinkedIn link is a placeholder (linkedin.com/in/kavya-nair-example). Web search for name + Yatrika + Jaipur + web developer returned nothing matching.

claims.text: Manish Joshi has 10 years running his family's travel agency in Jaipur, which has served over 3,000 families.
claims.note: Deck and form agree. Agency name not given; no independent trace found.

claims.text: Kavya Nair (technical co-founder) has 3 years as a web developer and no prior startup experience.
claims.note: No ML/AI background is claimed even though the product is pitched as 'planned by AI'.

claims.text: Both founders' LinkedIn links are placeholder URLs; no public footprint for either founder was found on the web.
claims.note: Searched name + company + city for both founders; no matching profiles, press or registry hits.

claims.text: Deck says Yatrika has 'served thousands of travellers'; the form states about 1,300 travellers across 410 bookings.
claims.note: 1,300 travellers is not 'thousands'. The deck inflates the only hard traction number the form gives.

claims.text: Deck claims operations across Rajasthan and Uttarakhand and that the company is 'growing across India'; the form gives Jaipur as the only location and describes acquisition as referrals from Manish's earlier agency customers plus Instagram.
claims.note: No booking split by region or city is given anywhere; 'strong brand' and 'growing across India' are unevidenced.

claims.text: Deck claims '3x growth' and 'many 5-star reviews' with no baseline, period or review source.
claims.note: No monthly bookings series or review platform given; no reviews found online.

claims.text: Total booking value since launch is INR 38.6 L; at a 12% commission revenue is INR 4.6 L.
claims.note: Arithmetic is consistent (38.6 L x 12% = 4.63 L). Implied average booking value ~INR 9,400 and commission ~INR 1,130 per booking (410 bookings).

claims.text: Paid acquisition costs about INR 640 per booking, against implied commission of ~INR 1,130 per booking.
claims.note: Our arithmetic: paid CAC consumes ~57% of first-booking commission before guide/taxi/ops costs. Share of bookings that are paid vs referral is not given.

claims.text: 14% of families have booked a second trip.
claims.note: No cohort window given; many early customers came from the founder's prior agency, which may flatter repeat.

claims.text: The 'AI' is a language model drafting itineraries over 40 hand-built route templates; bookings are confirmed manually on WhatsApp.
claims.note: Deck frames trips as 'planned by AI'; the form makes clear the product is templates plus manual operations. Founders themselves list manual operations that do not scale as a key risk.

claims.text: Company incorporated March 2026 (Yatrika Travel Pvt. Ltd.); both founders full-time since March 2026.
claims.note: Deck's 'in just 7 months' is consistent with a March 2026 start. No MCA/registry record for 'Yatrika Travel Pvt. Ltd.' surfaced in web search.

claims.text: Team size is 4 (form); the deck names only the two founders and gives no team size.
Raising INR 1.2 Cr at INR 8 Cr post-money; the deck's ask slide gives no amount, milestones or use-of-funds split.
claims.note: Use of funds is a generic list (marketing, technology, hiring, expansion) in both documents.

claims.text: Market sizing is a single top-down number (INR 3 lakh Cr Indian domestic tourism spend) with no SAM/SOM or family/Tier-2 share.
The deck repeats the same vision slide twice (slides 7 and 9) and the ask slide precedes the solution slide.
claims.note: Deck-quality observation from the file itself.

claims.text: Thrillophilia, an established travel-experience booking platform, is headquartered in Jaipur, Yatrika's home city.
Experiential-travel competitor WanderOn raised INR 54 Cr Series A in January 2026; press places it alongside Thrillophilia, TravelTriangle, Tripoto and Holidify.
MakeMyTrip launched a GenAI trip-planning assistant (Myra) in August 2025, live in English and Hindi with more Indian languages planned.
claims.note: Free AI itinerary generation is offered by the category leader, so the itinerary itself is not a moat.

claims.text: GuavaTrips (Pune, founded April 2024) offers free AI-generated personalised itineraries with end-to-end booking and concierge support.
claims.note: Source is a paid press release.

claims.text: Tier-2 and Tier-3 city travellers are driving a rise in festive travel demand (Thrillophilia Festive Travel Pulse 2025).
claims.note: Supports the Tier-2 demand thesis, but the source is a competitor's own report.

claims.text: Founder-listed key risks: quality of local partners, seasonality and manual operations that do not yet scale.
Sector selected as consumer tech; the business is a commission-based travel agency with a software front end, consistent with consumer_tech.

gaps.why_it_matters: The whole edge claimed is Manish's 10-year agency track record and 3,000-family customer base; none of it is independently traceable.
searched: web: "Yatrika" travel Jaipur AI family trips Manish Joshi
web: "Kavya Nair" Yatrika web developer Jaipur
gaps.ask_founder: What is the name and GSTIN of the family travel agency, how long has Manish run it, and can you share real LinkedIn/GitHub profiles for both founders?

gaps.what: Relationship between Yatrika and the family agency
gaps.why_it_matters: If most of the 410 bookings are the agency's existing customers moved onto WhatsApp, traction measures the old business, not new demand.
gaps.ask_founder: Of the 410 bookings, how many came from the family agency's prior customers vs Instagram vs paid ads? Is the agency still operating separately, and does it own any Yatrika equity or revenue?

gaps.why_it_matters: No MCA record, live website (www.yatrika.example is a placeholder), app listing or review page was found to corroborate the company exists as described.
searched: web: "Yatrika Travel" Private Limited Jaipur company registration
gaps.ask_founder: Please share the CIN, live website/Instagram handle and Google review page.

gaps.what: Month-by-month bookings and the basis of '3x growth'
gaps.why_it_matters: Seasonality is a stated risk; without a monthly series we cannot tell growth from a festive/summer spike.
gaps.ask_founder: Share bookings, GBV and revenue by month since launch, and define what grew 3x over what period.

gaps.why_it_matters: At ~INR 1,130 commission per booking and INR 640 paid CAC, manual WhatsApp operations and refunds could make each booking loss-making.
gaps.ask_founder: What is the operations cost (staff time, calls, cancellations/refunds) per booking, and what is contribution margin after CAC?

gaps.what: Supply side: number and vetting of local partners, especially outside Rajasthan
gaps.why_it_matters: Partner quality is the founders' own top risk and the core of 'led by locals'; deck claims Uttarakhand operations not mentioned in the form.
gaps.ask_founder: How many guides, taxi operators and stays are on the platform, by state, how are they vetted, and who is liable when a trip goes wrong?

gaps.what: Differentiation vs free AI planners and Jaipur-based Thrillophilia
gaps.why_it_matters: MakeMyTrip's Myra and others give AI itineraries free; the application names no competitors at all.
searched: web: MakeMyTrip AI trip planner Myra
gaps.ask_founder: Who do you lose bookings to today, and why would a Tier-2 family book through Yatrika rather than MakeMyTrip Holidays or a local agent?

gaps.what: Milestones for the INR 1.2 Cr raise
gaps.why_it_matters: Neither deck nor form says what the money achieves or how long it lasts.
gaps.ask_founder: What monthly bookings, cities and contribution margin will INR 1.2 Cr get you to, and over how many months?
